biggest_catch: Variable gig pay (81% of your own advertised price after the 19% contribution) with no guaranteed bookings — and no US presence, so it only works in its supported countries.
catches: Pawshake keeps a 19% contribution from every booking — you receive 81% of your advertised price.
Sitters set their own rates, so pay is variable with no guaranteed bookings.
All bookings must be paid via Pawshake — external/cash payments violate terms and can get your account suspended.
Operates in UK, Australia, Canada, NZ, Singapore and parts of Europe — no US presence.
Profiles with slow responses may become less visible; reliability affects bookings.

steps: Register free on Pawshake and create your sitter profile.
Set your own rates for dog walking, boarding, day care, house sitting, and cat sitting.
Pass Pawshake's manual profile checks (vetted profiles).
Offer free meet & greets, accept booking requests from pet owners.
Complete the booking; Pawshake keeps 19% and pays you 81% of your advertised price.
timing: Paid after the booking is complete (sitters are paid post-completion).
